import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/t')
import exact, gen, ref
ns = {}
exec(open('run3.py').read().split("rng = random.Random")[0], ns)
gen_trace = ns['gen_trace']
import random
rng = random.Random(1234)
ok = True
for trial in range(60):
    prof = gen.gen_profile(rng)
    fab = gen.gen_fabric(rng, prof, big=True)
    feas, upper, _ = ref.ref_calib(prof)
    c = exact.calibrate(prof)
    if c['status'] == 'inconsistent':
        assert set(c.keys()) == {'status', 'cycle'}, c.keys()
        assert isinstance(c['cycle'], list)
        continue
    assert set(c.keys()) == {'status', 'upper_ps', 'pred'}, c.keys()
    K = prof['groups']
    assert len(c['upper_ps']) == K and all(len(r) == K for r in c['upper_ps'])
    assert len(c['pred']) == K and all(len(r) == K for r in c['pred'])
    p = exact.compile_plan(prof, fab)
    assert set(p.keys()) == {'status', 'profile', 'period_rounds', 'peaks_as',
                             'guard_ns', 'bounds_as', 'age_rounds', 'pred',
                             'warmup_cycle'}, p.keys()
    assert p['status'] == 'ok'
    assert isinstance(p['period_rounds'], int) and p['period_rounds'] >= 1
    assert len(p['peaks_as']) == len(fab['guards_ns'])
    P = p['period_rounds']; N = fab['n']
    if p['guard_ns'] is None:
        assert p['bounds_as'] is None and p['age_rounds'] is None and p['pred'] is None and p['warmup_cycle'] is None
    else:
        assert p['guard_ns'] in fab['guards_ns']
        assert isinstance(p['guard_ns'], int)
        assert len(p['bounds_as']) == P and all(len(r) == N for r in p['bounds_as'])
        assert len(p['age_rounds']) == P and all(len(r) == N for r in p['age_rounds'])
        assert len(p['pred']) == P and all(len(r) == N for r in p['pred'])
        assert isinstance(p['warmup_cycle'], int) and p['warmup_cycle'] >= 0
        for row in p['bounds_as']:
            for cell in row:
                assert cell is None or (type(cell) is int and cell >= 0)
        for row in p['age_rounds']:
            for cell in row:
                assert cell is None or (type(cell) is int and cell >= 0)
        for row in p['pred']:
            for cell in row:
                assert cell is None or (isinstance(cell, list) and len(cell) == 2
                                        and type(cell[0]) is int and type(cell[1]) is int)
    a = exact.audit(prof, fab, p)
    assert set(a.keys()) == {'valid'} and a['valid'] is True
    tr = gen_trace(rng, prof, fab, upper)
    r = exact.replay(prof, fab, fab['guards_ns'][0], tr)
    assert set(r.keys()) == {'status', 'states', 'send_status', 'delivered',
                             'adopted', 'unknown_payloads', 'stale_payloads',
                             'pending', 'peak_known_abs_as', 'always_known'}, r.keys()
    assert r['status'] == 'ok'
    assert len(r['states']) == len(tr['queries'])
    for st in r['states']:
        assert set(st.keys()) == {'bounds_as', 'errors_as', 'adopted', 'generations'}
        assert len(st['bounds_as']) == N and len(st['errors_as']) == N
        assert len(st['adopted']) == N and len(st['generations']) == N
        for i in range(N):
            assert (st['bounds_as'][i] is None) == (st['errors_as'][i] is None)
            assert st['adopted'][i] is None or type(st['adopted'][i]) is int
            assert type(st['generations'][i]) is int
    assert len(r['send_status']) == len(tr['sends'])
    for s in r['send_status']:
        assert s in ('sent', 'lost', 'not_in_slice', 'blackout', 'guard', 'port_busy'), s
    for k in ('delivered', 'adopted', 'unknown_payloads', 'stale_payloads', 'pending', 'peak_known_abs_as'):
        assert type(r[k]) is int, (k, r[k])
    assert type(r['always_known']) is bool
print('SCHEMA VALIDATION OK (60 cases)')
EOF
